import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import os

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Separate features and target
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["id", "species"]]
X = train_df[feature_cols].values
y = train_df["species"].values
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].values

# Encode target
label_encoder = LabelEncoder()
y_encoded = label_encoder.fit_transform(y)
n_classes = len(label_encoder.classes_)

# Split for validation
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y_encoded, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_encoded
)

# Create LightGBM dataset
lgb_train = lgb.Dataset(X_train, y_train)
lgb_val = lgb.Dataset(X_val, y_val, reference=lgb_train)

# LightGBM parameters
params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": n_classes,
    "metric": "multi_logloss",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
}

# Train model
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    lgb_train,
    num_boost_round=1000,
    valid_sets=[lgb_train, lgb_val],
    callbacks=[
        lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False),
        lgb.log_evaluation(period=0),
    ],
)

# Validate on hold-out set
val_probs = model.predict(X_val)
val_logloss = log_loss(y_val, val_probs)
print(f"Validation Log Loss: {val_logloss:.6f}")

# Train final model on full data for submission
lgb_full = lgb.Dataset(X, y_encoded)
final_params = params.copy()
final_params["verbose"] = -1
final_model = lgb.train(final_params, lgb_full, num_boost_round=model.best_iteration)

# Predict on test set
test_probs = final_model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission file
# Ensure correct column order by using sample_submission as template
submission = sample_sub.copy()
class_names = sample_sub.columns[1:].tolist()

# Create probability matrix
prob_matrix = np.zeros((len(test_df), len(class_names)))
for i, prob in enumerate(test_probs):
    prob_matrix[i] = prob

# Create submission DataFrame
submission_probs = pd.DataFrame(prob_matrix, columns=class_names)
submission_probs.insert(0, "id", test_df["id"].values)

# Save submission
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission_probs.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"Submission saved with {len(submission_probs)} rows")
